samples.level_on: max observed qmax over the 7 target days

arrays.phase_share: [run, basin, lead, phase] share of |IG| for past 364 days / next 7 days / static attributes, mean over the basin's kept test samples at that lead
arrays.group_share: [run, basin, lead, group] share of |IG| by input source (past:*, fore:ECMWF, fore:GEFS, fore:REANALYSIS, static)
arrays.fore_day_share: [run, basin, lead, forecast day 1-7] share of |IG| of each forecast day's inputs
arrays.memory_L50 / memory_L90: [run, basin, lead] days back before issue date holding 50% / 90% of past-phase |IG|, median over the basin's kept samples
arrays.n_samples / n_samples_all: [basin, lead] kept samples (same for all runs) / [basin] all samples; NaN where 0

demo.lead: lead k = forecast for issue date + k - 1 (k = 1..7)
